about.title: We are Sendero.
about.lead: Yovany Luis's software agency: our own products, like Citania, and custom software.
body: Sendero is the software agency founded by Yovany Luis, a product engineer with more than eight years shipping production software. We map the path — from concept to production — and walk it with you.

We do two things. We build and operate our own products: the first is Citania, AI-powered WhatsApp attention for clinics (citania.mx). And we build custom software — web and mobile apps, AI agents and integrations — for companies that need to get to production.
Running our own products forces us to build like people who live with the result every day. We bring that same standard to every client project.
